title: RejectionReason
description: A stable, machine-readable rejection reason produced by the enforcement layer. Mirrors RejectionReason in crates/hook-core/src/reason.rs: the numeric code is the on-chain ContractError code (1-11) and the name is the stable snake_case identifier consumed by tooling and the safeguard-audit polyrepo. Never rename a variant.

code.description: ContractError / RejectionReason code. 1-11 are the rejection reasons; the contract adds its own codes above 11 (e.g. 12 already_initialized).

description.description: Human-readable meaning; never parsed by tooling.
